subject: Re-cert & renewal: SOC2 evidence + term/commit changes for renewal
body:
From: Sara Hamilton <sara.hamilton@acme-corp.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: contracts@acme-corp.com
Date: Thu, 5 Feb 2026 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: Renewal info needed: SOC 2 re-cert + retention for audit logs

Vivek,

As we prepare to renew our contract and move to the higher capacity tier we discussed (100k tokens/day committed), our security team has a couple of gating items before the renewal can progress:

- Confirmation of SOC 2 Type II re-attestation status and timeline (we need confirmation the scope includes your hosted API and any dedicated instances).
- A copy of the evidence checklist you plan to provide for the re-attestation (we will pass to our auditors).
- Clarification on audit log retention and the specific fields available in the logs (request/response metadata, timestamps, token counts, model id, region). Our compliance requires 3 years retention for audit logs or a documented retention/export process.

Also, procurement will need any proposed term changes or pricing/commitment language if we move forward with the expanded commit. Please send a single package (evidence checklist + sample logs + proposed amendment) so our legal and security teams can review in parallel.

Thanks,
Sara Hamilton
CISO, Acme Corp

---

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Feb 2026 13:05:12 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Renewal info needed: SOC 2 re-cert + retention for audit logs

Forwarding Acme's ask — they want a consolidated package (evidence checklist, sample logs showing retention/fields, and a term amendment covering the expanded commit + pricing). Target: get to them by EOD Mon 9 Feb.

Neha: can you confirm the commercial amendment draft and pricing for 100k/day commit (we discussed a blended 12-month ARR and an onboarding credit)?
Marissa: can you assemble the SOC2 re-attestation plan + evidence checklist and pull a redacted log sample that demonstrates the fields they requested. We need to confirm which logs are included for hosted vs dedicated.
Rafael: legal — we'll likely send a short amendment. Can you take a quick look at the standard commit amendment and mark any clauses that would affect audit data exports / retention?

I'll own the customer reply.

Thanks,
Vivek
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference

---

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 6 Feb 2026 09:00:47 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Renewal info needed: SOC 2 re-cert + retention for audit logs

Team — attaching a draft evidence checklist and a sample redacted log extract (log-sample-20260205.csv). Highlights:
- Our current SOC 2 Type II certification scope covers hosted API (production) and Dedicated when managed by Redwood; private/on-prem deployments are covered case-by-case.
- Re-attestation is on track; audit window closes 2026-03-21, final report available early April (we can provide an interim attestor letter in March if needed).
- Log fields available: request_id, timestamp_utc, model_id, prompt_id (redacted), bytes_in, bytes_out, token_count, region, route_id, processing_node_id.
- Retention: default tenant logs retained for 12 months in the console; we provide on-request exports for longer retention. For enterprise customers under contract we support 3-year retention via exported archives to a customer S3 (we'll set up the export job).

Action items: I will produce the evidence checklist PDF and the export manifest; Vivek/Neha to confirm we offer the 3-year export as part of the amend. Rafael: flag any NDAs/PII considerations for log exports.

Marissa Cole
Principal Compliance Manager | Redwood Inference

Attachments: evidence_checklist_20260205.pdf, log-sample-20260205.csv

---

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 8 Feb 2026 11:20:33 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Renewal info needed: SOC 2 re-cert + retention for audit logs

Quick read from legal perspective:
- We can include the 3-year retention option as a contract amendment that enables automated exported archives to the customer's S3. We should be explicit about the export mechanism (S3 URI + encryption key handling) and that Redwood will only store the exported archive for 30 days before deletion unless otherwise instructed.
- Remove any broad language that implies Redwood is responsible for customer-side long-term storage (clarify "export and handoff").
- Add a short data handling addendum saying Redwood will redact high-risk PII from logs prior to export unless the customer provides a signed transfer authorization.

I'll upload a marked-up amendment (redlines_terms_20260209.docx) by Monday.

Regards,
Rafael Mendes
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference

Attachment: redlines_terms_20260209.docx

---

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Sara Hamilton <sara.hamilton@acme-corp.com>
Cc: contracts@acme-corp.com, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Feb 2026 15:35:08 -0800
Subject: Renewal package: SOC2 timeline, logs, and proposed amendment (DEAL-4893)

Sara — thanks for the note and for outlining your needs. Attached is a consolidated package for Acme's review:

1) evidence_checklist_20260205.pdf — the checklist Marissa assembled showing what artifacts we'll provide for the re-attestation.
2) log-sample-20260205.csv — redacted sample demonstrating the fields we can export and a short explanation of each column.
3) redlines_terms_20260209.docx — Rafael's annotated amendment draft that includes the 3-year export/hand-off option and the handling/addendum language.

Summary and ask:
- SOC2 re-attestation: audit window closes 2026-03-21; final report early April. If your auditors need an interim attestor letter, we can provide a letter on 2026-03-05.
- Log retention: we offer automated export to Acme-managed S3 for 3-year retention. Export will include the listed fields; PII redaction is default unless Acme signs the transfer authorization form included in the attachment.
- Commercial/terms: Neha will send the proposed pricing sheet for the 100k tokens/day commit (12-month term) and the amendment with explicit export mechanics.

Next steps:
- Sara: please confirm Acme's preferred S3 bucket and the contact who will handle key exchange by EOD Wed 11 Feb so we can schedule the export job.
- Contracts: if the redlines look OK Rafael, we can package for signature (DocuSign link included).

Thanks — Vivek
Head of Sales | Redwood Inference

Attachments: evidence_checklist_20260205.pdf, log-sample-20260205.csv, redlines_terms_20260209.docx

---

From: Sara Hamilton <sara.hamilton@acme-corp.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: contracts@acme-corp.com
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal package: SOC2 timeline, logs, and proposed amendment (DEAL-4893)

Vivek — thanks for the quick turnaround and the consolidated packet. A few quick items:

- We will confirm S3 details and the key contact by end of day Thursday 12 Feb.
- Our auditors would like the interim attestor letter (that would help unblock procurement). Please send the attestor letter on 2026-03-05 as you suggested.
- One question from security: can you confirm whether response text is included in the export or only metadata? We need to know if full response bodies are available for the export (redaction rules may apply).

Procurement will review Rafael's redlines and get back on the amendment language. If everything looks good we'll plan to execute the amendment and the DocuSign flow next week.

Appreciate the coordination — Sara
CISO, Acme Corp

---

[End of thread]
